quizName:
Hardest Questions in Idaho
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must you show the officer?
questions.explanation: You must have your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your vehicle at all times. You must show all three when stopped.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up and you should get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: If you are in a serious crash, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop and move your vehicle off the road if possible. Check if anyone is hurt and call 911 if needed. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, someone dies, or damage is over $1,000 (or over $200 to government property like signs or guardrails).

questions.question: Using a cell phone while driving:

options.text: Is not a problem in Idaho.
Distracts drivers and can cause crashes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Distracts drivers and can cause crashes.
questions.explanation: Using a cell phone while driving distracts you and causes crashes. In Idaho, texting while driving is illegal. Hands-free devices are allowed.

questions.question: When you see an aggressive driver, what should you do?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between your vehicle and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not look at them or make rude gestures.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a steep hill coming. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid a crash.

questions.question: When borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend, you should:

options.text: Not worry because all vehicles are the same.
Hide that you are unfamiliar with the car.
Ignore obvious defects to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where everything is and how it works before you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where everything is and how it works before you drive.
questions.explanation: Take time to find and understand the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear shifter, and horn. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even small amounts of alcohol hurt your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be prepared to stop for trains or other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: You should slow down:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, on sharp or blind curves, around pedestrians, near hazards, and on wet or slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn about railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile they drive. You need to focus on driving at all times. Any other activity can be dangerous.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. A right turn is prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm extended, you should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait to proceed.
Honk your horn before passing on the left.
Keep driving when you think the children are done exiting.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait to proceed.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has its stop arm out, you must stop completely. Do not move until the stop arm is pulled back in.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yellow light and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. Where this sign is posted, you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: Can pass a slow vehicle if you are quick.
Can pass if you know the road.
Can pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs with black markings are regulatory signs. You must obey them. Where this sign is posted, passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: A driver's ability to drive safely can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and drowsiness can all reduce your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: You are angry after something that happened at work. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive home.
Stop at a bar and have a few drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, take time to calm down before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: Allow room for vehicles merging onto the freeway by:

options.text: Suddenly slowing down to give them space.
Always driving in the far left lane.
Safely moving out of the right lane to give them space.
Honking your horn to warn them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Safely moving out of the right lane to give them space.
questions.explanation: Drive in the right or center lane normally. When a vehicle enters from a ramp on your right, safely move to the next lane to let them in. During rush hour, avoid the right lane to make room for more merging traffic.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your exit. You should:

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your current lane.
Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway. Instead, continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other vehicles are visible.
Signal only if other vehicles are visible.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other vehicles are visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when you turn, change lanes, or pull away from a curb. This is a law you must always follow.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see emergency vehicles with flashing lights coming from behind?

options.text: Speed up to stay ahead of them.
Slow down but do not stop.
Pull to the curb or edge of the road and stop immediately.
Keep driving and turn on your hazard lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the curb or edge of the road and stop immediately.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle is coming toward you with flashing lights or a siren, pull to the nearest curb or edge and stop right away. Stay stopped until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: In which ways can alcohol affect you?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time and coordination. It also harms your vision and your ability to judge distance. These effects make it hard to react safely to what is around you.
